stem:
Aditya examines three labelled slides: thin flat cheek cells, a long nerve cell with branches, and spindle-shaped muscle cells from the food pipe. He knows cheek cells form a protective lining, nerve cells carry messages, and muscle cells contract to help move food.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The thin flat shape of cheek cells helps them form a protective lining; the long branched shape of the nerve cell helps it carry messages.
The nerve cell is long because carrying messages stretches it.
Cheek cells and the nerve cell in Aditya's body have the same shape and the same function.
The long nerve cell moves food down the food pipe because both the cell and the food pipe are long.

teacher.key_rationale: Cell shape and structure suit function: thin flat cheek cells line and protect; long branched nerve cells carry messages. Length is not caused by stretching, shapes are not the same across cell types, and nerve cells do not move food.
